description.value: Haslam Creek Berry Farm is a certified organic U-pick blueberry operation on Rugby Road outside Nanaimo, offering two varieties of blueberries — Chandler and Draper — during the summer and early fall picking season. The farm operates on a seasonal schedule with weekend picking days during harvest, making it a potential detour for cyclists passing through the Nanaimo area seeking fresh local produce. Cash and e-transfer are the only accepted payment methods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page is accessible and confirms the farm is active, with a post from September 17, 2025 announcing the last U-pick weekend of the season. The phone number (250) 797-0623 and address 2900 Rugby Rd. match the OSM tags exactly, though the Facebook page lists the city as Nanaimo while the OSM community field says Ladysmith. No mention of bike parking, water access, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Ladysmith' but Facebook profile explicitly lists the address as 'Nanaimo, BC' with postal code V9X 1T2 — the correct community may be Nanaimo, not Ladysmith.
Operation is seasonal (U-pick blueberry season only, typically summer through mid-fall); cyclists visiting off-season will find it closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, real seasonal farm business with a post as recently as September 2025; useful to touring cyclists seeking fresh local produce in the Nanaimo area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address blueberryfarm2019@gmail.com found on Facebook page but not present in OSM tags.

wow_evidence: certified organic U-pick blueberry operation on Rugby Road outside Nanaimo
